## About
Edison Collision is a family-owned and operated auto body shop based in Edison, serving drivers across Central Jersey. We've built strong relationships in this community, and we take real care with every car that comes through our shop.
We handle collision repair, dent repair, paint and post-accident restoration, along with frame and unibody alignment, color matching, rust repair and custom work. We also take care of mechanical, suspension and electrical repairs.
Whether your repair is paid for by an insurance company or out of your own pocket, you get the same service. We offer free estimates, help with insurance claims, rental car assistance and a key drop box to make the whole thing less stressful.

## Services
- Metal, plastic and fiberglass bodywork: Precise bodywork repairs on metal, plastic and fiberglass.
- Frame and unibody alignment: A computerized system to get your car's structure lined up correctly.
- Color matching: Accurate color matching so repaired panels blend with the rest of your car.
- Restoration and rust repair: We restore vehicles and repair signs of rust.
- Custom colors and graphics: Custom colors and graphics to change up the look of your car.
- Mechanical repairs: Mechanical, suspension and electrical work.
- Glass replacement: We can replace damaged glass on your vehicle.
- Free estimates: Free in-house computerized estimates at the shop. (Free)

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on cars paid for by insurance or out of pocket?
A: Both. You get the same service whether your repair is funded by an insurance company or you're paying yourself.

Q: Is there a fee for field service estimates?
A: A fee may apply for a field service estimate if we don't end up repairing the vehicle.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on the North side of Route 1 in Edison, between the two Old Post Rd intersections.
